entities.name: Germanic Tribes
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Tribal peoples including the Goths, Vandals, Franks, Saxons, and Lombards who emerged in Scandinavia and northern Germany. Tacitus described their warrior culture, thing assemblies, and fierce independence.
